description: Returns one campaign's creators in one reply: a page of the creators the latest finished creator search found, in the order it served them except that creators with no followers, country or category on record come last, marked profile not checked, then the campaign roster (up to 15 creators already added, with their outreach status and no contact emails). Each found creator's first line carries the candidate id, the handle as a profile link, the display name, followers, the engagement percentage, country, languages, categories, typical recent views and posts a month; the lines under it carry the confirmed criteria it matched, the reasons the search recorded, the criteria verdicts, and quoted bio and caption excerpts. The reply's table has one row per found creator: the Avatar column carries the creator's picture link when one is stored and no candidate card shows them, the TikTok Shop affiliate column says yes, no or not checked, and the Engagement rate column shows the percentage, or unknown when a creator has none. When the reply says the candidate card already shows the found creators, the card carries their photos. candidate_ids lists a narrowed or re-ordered choice of found creators, so the card shows only their pictures. The Email on file column shows the address that drafting uses, none, or opted out; a caller who cannot edit the brand's campaigns sees yes in place of an address. Account type, content themes and recent post links come with a creator's detail, not this list. Page 1 without candidate_ids on a TikTok or TikTok Shop campaign ends with the TikTok Shop sales section: orders and GMV per creator who sold in this campaign, a different figure from a creator's GMV for the last 30 days, or one sentence saying why no figure is shown. Page 1 also names creators recorded as emailed from the marketer's own mailbox. sort_by gmv names the creators on a page that hold no GMV. Example: campaign_id spring-launch, sort_by followers, fields compact.

candidate_ids.description: Lists only these found creators, by the candidate ids this list gives, in the list order; page, limit and found_up_to do not apply. Omit it to list a page.

fields.description: full (default) prints every line. compact leaves out bio and caption excerpts and post links and keeps every count, disclosure, verdict and provenance line.

found_up_to.description: The found_up_to time a page 1 reply names. Pass it unchanged with page 2 and later so the pages keep the same creators while a repeat search adds more; page 1 ignores it.

sort_by.description: Order of the served list across all pages, applied before paging. rank (default) is the order the search served. followers and engagement put the highest first and a creator with no number last. gmv keeps the served order while no creator carries a numeric GMV to sort by. A sort never starts a new search.
